svg.text: Rules score every case first; a deterministic router decides how much AI reasoning each case gets; guardrails and humans have the last word.
= one case's path through the system
vanilla JS single-page app (web/) · no build step · hash routing
identity via X-Actor / X-Role headers · UI assets served no-cache with versioned URLs
per-case + queue AI; batch triage in
ingest + re-score every case; blocklist enforcement (DECLINED, auto-release)
notes (hard delete + purge of assessments/chat/audit text), feedback, dispositions
bulk-clear guardrails; escalation → supervisor; outcomes (fraud/legit) + R17 re-score
input_hash = rules + score + notes + feedback + related-case notes → staleness
rulestore: custom rules (validated DSL, no code exec), built-in overrides, versions, audit
backtest: precision/recall/F1 + Wilson CI; labels = leave-one-out | AI | outcomes | blend
blocklist: claim/provider/member lists, segments, hard conditions, fraud-history rules
governance: investigators propose, supervisors activate; >25% of queue needs confirmation
related.py: linked cases + nearest-by-signal + confirmed outcomes → context for agents
clusters: co-firing rule groups; abnormal fire-rates by care type/state/month (exact binomial)
briefing: headlines (no LLM), stats, optional grounded narrative
evals: invariants, counterfactual/injection tests, shadow A/B vs single judge
no LLM · every case is scored here first · re-runs on every ingest / rule / outcome change
derived: travel miles, log-z, amount vs
Router sends each case to exactly one lane
AGENT LAYER — LLM reasoning under a bounded, traced harness
app/agents + app/llm · pure Python, no agent framework
no rule fired, no linked case
only where a domain fired: billing ·
contested = low confidence · challenger 'high' · specialists disagree · AI band ≠ rule band · score within 5 of a band cut
±20 clamp, level derived · citations re-verified vs record · no CLEAR on HIGH/CRITICAL or R17 · linked-CRITICAL floor · figure check

budgets (steps · tools · tokens · time) · tool allowlists · typed output + repair (2×) · fast→strong escalation · no-progress stop · spans, tokens, reference cost per call · fail-closed (LLM unavailable, never invented)
ReAct loop over the tools below; sees case packet, AI assessment, all notes, audit tail
English → validated DSL rule; never auto-saved
restricted to computed stats / case file; figures verified
specialists get ≤1 tool; verifier, challenger, panel none
OpenRouter chat-completions · reasoning off (measured 3× faster, avoids empty replies)
model tiers (fast / strong) · rate limiter · per-model circuit breaker · multi-model fallback chain · token + latency accounting · record/replay cassette (offline, deterministic evals)
OpenRouter → free-tier models, tried in order
also: chat · escalations · kv (briefing cache) · calibration.json · cassette.json
Feedback loops that close the circle (dashed)
note / feedback / outcome / rule change → input_hash changes → assessment stale → crew re-assesses only what changed (specialists reused by evidence-slice hash)
Mark as FRAUD → outcome row → lookalikes fire R17 and re-score → clearing them is blocked; supervisor override of a decline → false-positive signal on that blocklist entry
